findings.statement: axes.genericity_kind is 'unresolved' (research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml:393, sha256 0abb9ed8a961) while conclusion.text asserts a residual/comeager quantifier (line 414: 'For a comeager set G of data in the class, chosen before and independently of the data'); the conclusion field carries no provisional or claim_status marker. genericity_value_status is 'unresolved_pending_L1' (line 395).

Hypothesis H4 (line 407) is flagged unresolved:true and states the genericity notion 'is unresolved and must be named before any claim is filed', yet the class carries a specific-quantifier conclusion (line 414) and no machine-readable claim block (no conclusion.provisional, no claim_status=blocked_by_unresolved_hypothesis). This is exactly the field pair CF-21 records as reviewer-split; the declared checker decides it FAIL.

The class_scope_adjudication D3 record (line 81) says the comeager quantifier is 'confirmed discharged for ALL FOUR classes, including AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH'. At the measured bytes that record is not supported for this class: its declared kind is unresolved, no F-node schema binds it, and H4's 'before any claim is filed' condition is unmet. Either the D3 record or the class declaration must be corrected.

No class in F0 carries a per-class genericity_topology field, although the file's own field rule requires a generic-quantified claim to name genericity_kind AND genericity_topology. The three owned classes discharge the topology in their rev12 schemas (genericity.topology_or_measure); the scalar class has neither. Soft: advisory for the F0 revision, not a gate blocker by itself.

New declared checker with a fail-closed self-test: baseline FAIL with exactly the two hard failures above; 7/7 pre-registered in-memory mutants behave as declared (C01 repair -> PASS; C02 cosmetic rename -> still FAIL G5+G6; C03 quantifier mismatch -> G3; C04 missing field -> G1 no crash; C05 bare generic -> G4; C06 empty doc -> G0 no crash; C07 schema kind mismatch -> S3+G6). No frozen byte written; input hashes re-measured before/after with zero drift.

The other three classes PASS the hard rules at the measured hashes: provisional_baire_residual resolves to residual_comeager via VOCAB_ALIASES.json and each is discharged by exactly one binding schema declaring residual_comeager with a named topology and generic set.
